content: Yesu Akasɩ́pʋ́ Gyankpapʋ Tɩ
Ɛkɛ ɔkʋ Yesu lɩ́ɩ́ Genesaret paatɩ
ɔnɔ́, ahá tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ bɛba boputá mʋ ánɩ́ bónu Bulu asʋ́n.
Olowun nklʋn anyɔ paatɩ ámʋ ɔnɔ́. Aye alɛpʋ́ ámʋ bakplɩ́ yɔ́ bʋdɛ amʋ́ asawutɔ da.
Yesu lɔ́dʋ wíé kʋlɛá igyi Simon klɛ́tɔ. Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛbláa Simon ɔbɛ́ɛ, osún mʋ́ kpalobí dɩnka ntsusʋ. Ɩnʋ oletsiá mʋ́tɔ́ súná ahá ámʋ atɔ́.
Brɛ́á ɔlɔtɔɩ́ tá á, ɔlɛbláa Simon ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩpla ɔklʋn amʋ ya okluklúkpá, amlɩyɔtswɩ asawu lɛ aye.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Simon lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Owíé, anɩlɔ́bwɛ kásíán ígye onyé fɛ́ɛ́, anɩménya tɔtɔ. Támɛ ɩ́nɩá fɛɛ ayɔ́, sʋ nɔ́yɔtswɩ asawu amʋ.”
Brɛ́á bɔyɔ́tswɩ asawu amʋ a, bɛlɛ aye tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ. Mʋ́ sʋ asawu amʋ lɔ́wa tɩtɩ́ɩ bɩ.
Ɩnʋ bɔbwɛ ɩbɩ tɩ́ amʋ́ agyʋ́má ayɔbá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋbʋ ɔklʋn nyɔɔsɩtɔ ámʋ bɛɛ bʋbɛ́tsa amʋ́. Bɛba bɛtsa amʋ́, bɛlɛ aye amʋ bʋ́lá nklʋn anyɔ ámʋ dɛ́dɛ́ɛ́dɛ́, ideklé ɩmɛ.
Brɛ́á Simon Petro lówun mʋ́ alɩ á, ɔlɛda akpawunu Yesu ayabitɔ, bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Wíé, mákpʋkpɛ́ mantáa mɩ! Lakpan ɔbwɛpʋ́ ngyi.”
Tsúfɛ́ aye amʋ́ʋ́ balɛ́ ámʋ lɔwa mʋa mʋ aba ámʋ wánwan.
Alɩ kɛ́n ɩlɔwa Sebedeo abí Yakobo mʋa Yohane, bʋgyi Simon agyʋ́má ayɔbá ámʋ ɛ́ wánwan nɩ́. Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa Simon ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mánya ifú! Tsú ndɛ pʋ́ya a, anyánkpʋ́sa fɛ́lɛ.”
Simon mʋa mʋ aba ámʋ benya plá nklʋn amʋ besi otsubúnɔ alɩ, besi tógyítɔ́ tswɩ, kplá buo Yesu.
Ɩlɔ Pɛpɛ Ɔlɔpʋ́ Ɔkʋ Tsa
Ɛkɛ ɔkʋ Yesu bʋ wúlu kʋsʋ, ɩlɔ pɛpɛ ɔlɔpʋ́ ɔkʋ lówun mʋ. Ɩnʋ ɔlɛbɛda akpawunu, pʋ́ ɔsʋkpɩ yi ɔsʋlʋ́tɔ, kókóli mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Owíé, nɩ́ fótsulá á, fɛ́talɩ́ há mɩ́ ɩwɩ bɛ́plɩ.”
Yesu lɛ́tɩnkɩ́ ɩbɩ da mʋ, bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Natsúlá, fʋ́ ɩwɩ ɩplɩ́ɩ.” Ɩnʋnʋ ɩlɔ ámʋ lɛ́ŋa lɛ mʋ ɩwɩ.

Ɩnʋ Yesu lɛ́da mʋ ɔlá ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mábla ɔhaa. Natɩ laa afʋpʋ fʋ́ ɩwɩ yosuná Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́, afʋha mʋ ɩwɩgyʋrátɔ amʋ́ʋ́ Mose mbla losuná tsú ɩlɔ pɛpɛtsa ɩwɩ ámʋ. Igyi adánsɩɛ suna ahá ánɩ́ fʋ́ ɩwɩ laplɩ́ɩ.”
Támɛ Yesu ɩwɩ asʋ́n lɛ́trá klɛɩ́ yɔ́ ntɩ́nɛ́ dɩ́nká mʋ́sʋ́. Ɔdɔm bɛba mʋ atosunáhɛ́ onukpá, ɔtsa amʋ́tɔ́ alɔpʋ ɛ́ ɩlɔ.
Támɛ oletsiá dálɩ amʋ́tɔ́ brɛ́ kʋ yɔ́ dimbísʋ́ ɔtɩnɛkʋ mʋ nkʋlɛ yɔ́bɔ mpáɩ.
Tsukʋlɛ Osínpʋ Tsa
Ɛkɛ ɔkʋ Yesu dɛ́ atɔ́ suná. Farisifɔ, Mose mbla asunápʋ́ akʋá botsú Galilea pʋ́ Yudea ɔmátɔ́ pʋ́ Yerusalem bɛba betsiá asɩ ɩnʋ. Bulu túmi bʋ Yesutɔ há ɩlɔtsa.
Ɩnʋ á, ayin akʋ bɔsʋrá tsukʋlɛ osínpʋ akpasʋ ba. Bekleá bɔ́pʋ mʋ wíé wóyítɔ́, pʋ́ mʋ tswɩ Yesu ansɩ́tɔ́.
Ɔdɔm amʋ sʋ bʋmenya ɔkpa. Ɩ́nɩ sʋ bɔyɔ́dʋ obu ámʋ awunso, dá mʋ́ ɔtɩnɛkʋ tíí, bɛkplɩ́a akpa amʋ tswɩ ahá ámʋtɔ Yesu ansɩ́tɔ́ ɩnʋ.
Brɛ́á Yesu lówun ánɩ́ bahɔ mʋ gyi a, ɔlɛbláa tsukʋlɛ osínpʋ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Opíó, nasí fʋ́ lakpan kíé fʋ́.”
Mose mbla asunápʋ́ pʋ́ Farisifɔ ámʋ bɛblɩ́ wá nwuntɔ bɛɛ, “Ma gyí oyin ánfɩ ɔdɛ abususʋ blɩ́ ánfɩ? Ma ɔbɛ́talɩ́ sí lakpan kíé ahá dʋn Bulu nkʋlɛ?”
Yesu lɛ́bɩ amʋ́ agywɩɩn. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ mlɩdɛ́ ɩ́nɩ odu gywɩɩ́n?
Mɔmʋ lɔ́pɔn ha blɩ́? ‘Nasí fʋ́ lakpan kíé fʋ́.’ lóó, ntɛ́ɛ ‘Kʋsʋ tsu fʋ́ akpa afʋnatɩ?’

Támɛ ndekléá mlɩbɩ́ɩ ánɩ́ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ mbʋ túmi ɔyɩ́ ánfɩtɔ sí ahá lakpan kíé amʋ́.” Ɩnʋ ɔlɛbláa tsukʋlɛ osínpʋ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ndɛ fʋ́ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, kʋsʋ. Tsu fʋ́ akpa afʋnatɩ yɔ wóyí!”
Ɩnʋnʋʋnʋ tsukʋlɛ osínpʋ amʋ lɔ́kʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ ansɩ́tɔ́, tsú mʋ akpa, ɔlɔpʋ ɔkpa ɔyɔ́ wóyí ɔdɛ Bulu kanfʋ́.
Ɔnɔ́ lobwie ahá ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́. Ifú lowie amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́tɔ́, bɛkanfʋ́ Bulu bɛɛ, “Ndɛ anɩlawun ofúla!”
Lewi Tɩ
Mʋ́ ɔma brɛ́á Yesu lɛ́dalɩ ɩnʋ á, olowun lampóo ɔhɔ́pʋ ɔkʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Lewi, tsie mʋ lampóo ɔhɔ́kpa. Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Bobuo mɩ.”
Ɩnʋ Lewi lɔ́kʋsʋ́, sí mʋ tógyítɔ́ ɔmagyáa, yóbuo mʋ.
Mʋ́ ɔma a, Lewi lɔ́tswɩ ɔpʋ́nʋ́ mʋ wóyítɔ́ há Yesu. Lampóo ahɔ́pʋ tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ pʋ́ aha bambá ɛ́ bɛba atɔ́ ámʋ ogyíkpá.
Farisifɔ pʋ́ Mose mbla asunápʋ́ ánɩ́ bʋbʋ Farisifɔ ámʋtɔ bɛfɩtɛ́ Yesu akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɛɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ mlɩa lampóo ahɔ́pʋ pʋ́ lakpan abwɛpʋ́ mlɩdɛ́ ɩbɩ wa gyi atɔ́, mlɩdɛ́ ntá nú?”
Yesu lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Alɔpʋ léhián ɩlɔ ɔtsapʋ́, megyí ahá ánɩ́ ɩwɩ bʋ amʋ́ ɔnlɩn.
Mmɛba aha wankláán ɔtɩkpá. Mboún lakpan abwɛpʋ́ ɔtɩkpá nɛba, mɛ́nɩ bɛ́damlí klʋntɔ.”
Ɔnɔ́klɩ́ Ɩwɩ Asʋn Fɩtɛ́hɛ́
Aha akʋ bɛbláa Yesu bɛɛ, “Asú Ɔbɔpʋ́ Yohane akasɩ́pʋ́ bʋtetsíá klɩ́ ɔnɔ́ bɔ́ mpáɩ. Farisifɔ akasɩ́pʋ́ ɛ́ bʋtɔbwɛ́ alɩ, támɛ fʋ́ akasɩ́pʋ́ mʋ́ bʋdegyí, bʋdenúu.”
Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔtsɩ ɔkpaɩ́npʋ́ anyawíe bɛ́klɩ́ ɔnɔ́ brɛ́á ɔbʋ amʋ́ wá? Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ!
Támɛ ɛkɛ ɔkʋ bɛ́ba ánɩ́ bɛ́kpa mʋ nátɩ́ sí amʋ́. Alɩ nkɛ ámʋtɔ bɛ́klɩ́ ɔnɔ́ nɩ́.”
Ɩnʋ ɔlɛha amʋ́ yébi ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔhaa tamapʋ́ tati pɔpwɛ tan tati dada. Nɩ́ ɔbwɛ́ mʋ́ alɩ á, alayíntá pɔpwɛ amʋ, pɔpwɛ amʋ pʋ́ dada amʋ ansɩ́ ɛ́ ɩmɛ́ɛkanáa aba.
Alɩ kɛ́n bʋtamapʋ́ nta pɔpwɛ wá ɔwʋlʋ́-kpákpá kɛntɛ wuhɛ́tɔ́ nɩ́. Nta pɔpwɛ amʋ ibófu fá kɛntɛ amʋ tsítsá, yíntá kɛntɛ amʋ ɛ́.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ɔwʋlʋ́-kpákpá kɛntɛ pɔpwɛtɔ bʋ́tɔpʋ́ nta pɔpwɛ wá.
Ɔhaa tamafɩ́tɛ́ nta pɔpwɛsʋ brɛ́á alanu dánhɛ. Tsúfɛ́ ɔtɛblɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Ɩdánhɛ amʋ bʋ alɛ́ dʋn.’ ”
